test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 12 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements is correct about oxidation reaction?

options.text: Oxidation is gain of oxygen and hydrogen.
Oxidation is loss of oxygen and hydrogen.
Oxidation is gain of oxygen or loss of hydrogen.
Oxidation is loss of oxygen or gain of hydrogen.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Oxidation is gain of oxygen or loss of hydrogen.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**Oxidation:

__
 
• It is a process where a substance loses electrons and becomes more positively charged.
 
• It is often accompanied by the gain of oxygen or loss of hydrogen.
 
• For example, when iron rusts, it undergoes oxidation by reacting with oxygen in the air.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**Reduction:

 
• It is a process where a substance gains electrons and becomes more negatively charged.
 
• It is often accompanied by the loss of oxygen or gain of hydrogen.
 
• It is used in manufacturing of cement.
 
• For example, when silver ions gain electrons to form silver metal, they undergo reduction.

Neutralisation:

 
• It is a reaction that occurs between an acid and a base to form a salt and water.
 
• The acid and base cancel out each other's properties, resulting in a neutral pH.
 
• In wastewater treatment, this technique is employed to lessen the harm that the effluents cause.
 
• It is employed in the process of making antacid pills.
 
• A strong acid and strong base neutralized has a pH of seven.
